item.title: City council approves riverside park plan
item.description: Councillors voted 12-3 to fund the first phase of the project.

item.title: Local team wins inter-district cricket final
item.description: A late partnership sealed a four-wicket win on Sunday.

item.title: New night bus routes begin trial run
item.description: Three routes will run hourly between midnight and 4 am.

item.title: Public library extends weekend hours
item.description: The central branch will stay open two hours longer on Saturdays.

item.title: Farmers market adds winter stalls
item.description: Organisers expect twenty new vendors through January.
